records.title: 10-K
records.text: For Fiscal 2024, net sales increased 16%, as compared to Fiscal 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: High-single-digit growth in unit volume also contributed to the increase in net sales, following increases in traffic and transactions in Company-owned and operated channels.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The percentage decrease was primarily attributable to cost of sales leverage from a higher AUR on reduced promotions, as well as a benefit in product costs, as certain raw material prices have declined.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: A discussion of the Company’s financial condition, changes in financial condition and liquidity as of February 1, 2025, which includes (i) an analysis of changes in cash flows for Fiscal 2024 as compared to Fiscal 2023, (ii) an analysis of liquidity, including availability under the Company’s credit facility, and outstanding debt and covenant compliance and (iii) a summary of contractual and other obligations as of February 1, 2025.
